spam.definition:
n. a canned meat made largely from pork
n. unwanted e-mail (usually of a commercial nature sent out in bulk)
v. send unwanted or junk e-mail
spam.translation:
n. 罐头猪肉, 垃圾邮件
v. 发送垃圾邮件

spammed.translation: v. 香火腿( spam的过去式和过去分词 ); （斯帕姆）午餐肉; 垃圾邮件; （非索要的）电邮广告

spammer.definition: n. someone who sends unwanted email (often in bulk)

spamophilia.translation: 痉挛素质; 痉挛素质
